basic_info.description: Tastefully upgraded 5BD/2BA home in the desirable Outer Parkside neighborhood offering flexibility, function, and style. The upper level features 3BD/1BA, a bright open layout, modern kitchen with quartz counters, new appliances, and new flooring. Downstairs, the 2BD/1BA space includes its own contemporary kitchen and upgrades ideal for guests, rental potential, or extended family. A private laundry area, 1-car garage, and a large backyard with a striking china jade-colored deck round out the features. Enjoy a beachside lifestyle just moments from Top Rated Schools, Ocean Beach, SF Zoo, and the Great Highway, with quick access to Muni, Sunset Blvd, and Sloat.
